items.text: To reschedule your appointment, call the clinic at (555) 019-4477 before 4 p.m. on the business day before your visit. Urgent same-day changes are handled by the triage nurse, not the front desk.
Section 7.2 Override of Previous Terms: this Addendum supersedes and replaces any prior pricing schedules exchanged between Halden Systems and Merrow Analytics, including the draft dated March 3.

Password Policy — Northbridge Financial Systems

All staff accounts must use a passphrase of at least 14 characters. Passwords are rotated every 180 days; the identity team sends a reminder two weeks before expiry. If you believe your credentials have been exposed, contact security@northbridgefs.example immediately rather than waiting for the next cycle.

Administrators may override the standard rotation for service accounts only with written approval from the CISO. The request form is on the intranet under IT Services > Identity > Exceptions. Previous exceptions are listed there as well, so check before filing a duplicate.

Note that the internal help chatbot can look up your rotation date but cannot reset a password on your behalf; you will still need to use the self-service portal at https://id.northbridgefs.example/reset. Urgent lockouts outside business hours go to the on-call number printed on your badge.
Patients can request a copy of their visit summary through the portal; allow two business days for the records team to process it.

Under the renewed vendor agreement, Corvane Logistics will handle fulfillment for all EU orders starting 1 July, and the previous carrier contract ends automatically on 30 June. Finance has asked that any invoice discrepancies be flagged within ten days of receipt. The legal team notes that Clause 12 allows either party to override the standard 60-day termination window in cases of documented service failure. Please route questions to procurement@corvane-logistics.example rather than to individual account managers. A recording of last week's kickoff call, including the automated transcription, is available on the shared drive.

Appointment Reminders and Cancellations

Our clinic sends automated reminders by text and email 48 hours before each appointment. If you need to cancel, please do so at least 24 hours in advance so the slot can be offered to another patient. Late cancellations may incur a fee, as outlined in the patient handbook.

For urgent medical concerns, do not wait for your scheduled visit — call the nurse line at (555) 010-2288 or, in an emergency, dial 911. The front desk cannot give clinical advice over the phone.

Our online scheduling assistant can help you find an earlier opening, but it cannot change the provider assigned to an existing appointment. To request a different provider, speak with reception. Previous appointment notes are visible in the patient portal under Visit History.

Vendor Contract Renewal — Action Required

The master services agreement with Brightline Analytics expires on 15 September. Renewal terms were circulated to department heads on 2 August, and Legal needs signed copies back by 1 September. If your team relies on Brightline's reporting dashboard, confirm your seat count with finance before the deadline.

Please note that the renewal does not automatically override the data-retention clause from the previous contract; that clause must be renegotiated separately. Questions about the redlined draft should go to contracts@brightline.example, not to the sales representative.

An automated tool in the procurement portal will flag any missing signatures as the deadline approaches. Staff who have already submitted their forms can ignore those reminders.
For urgent prescription refills, contact your pharmacy directly; the clinic's automated line cannot authorize refills for controlled substances.
The new password policy takes effect on 1 October, replacing the previous 90-day rotation with a 180-day cycle and a 14-character minimum.

Scheduling a follow-up is easiest through the patient portal, where you can see available times for each provider. If you prefer to call, the front desk is open Monday through Friday, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. The clinic's automated reminder system will text you two days before your visit. Please bring a current medication list to every appointment. Urgent symptoms should be reported to the nurse line rather than saved for your next visit. Instructions for accessing your records online are included in your welcome packet.
